note: Generic seeded random tables: names, rumours, loot, weather, encounters. Nothing here is tied to a published setting.

templates: They say {person} has not been seen at {place} since the last {event}.
A carter swears {creature} were heard below {place} three nights running.
Half the taproom believes {person} is paying good coin for {thing}.
The talk at the well is that {place} will be closed by order before the month turns.
Somebody found {thing} in the mud outside {place} and nobody will say whose it was.
There is a price on {person}, quietly, and it grows every week.
Since the {event}, nobody who walks past {place} after dark comes back the same.
{person} owes a debt that is not measured in coin, and the collectors are near.
They buried something under {place} a generation ago and it has started to knock.
The road past {place} is cursed, or bandits are clever - either way, take the long way.
A child claims {creature} spoke to them by name outside {place}.
{person} sold {thing} twice, to two buyers, and only one of them knows.
